# Grade against the contract, not the cohort

The scorecards that survived vendor pushback graded each vendor against its own
contracted commitments; the ones that ranked vendors against each other collapsed in
the first meeting, because every vendor has a reason the comparison is unfair.
A grade that says "you committed to a four-hour response window and hit it 83 percent
of the quarter, tickets attached" ends the argument before it starts.
